title: Fair sharing: borrow idle capacity, give it back when asked
purpose: One team borrows what others are not using. When an owner comes back for its share, the borrower is preempted and requeued, and the owner runs.

steps.display: kubectl --context cpu-a get clusterqueue   # llm 2, vision 1, research 1 CPU, one cohort
steps.output:
NAME           COHORT      PENDING WORKLOADS
llm-cpu        cpu-fleet   0
research-cpu   cpu-fleet   0
vision-cpu     cpu-fleet   0

steps.display: kubectl --context cpu-a create -f job.yaml   # research/research-run: queue cpu, 3 pod(s) x cpu 1
scripts/fleet-status.py queues   # research uses 3 CPUs: its own 1 plus 2 borrowed

scripts/fleet-status.py workloads   # the owner is admitted; the borrower has been evicted and requeued
steps.output:
CLUSTER  NAMESPACE WORKLOAD                           STATE
cpu-a    llm       job-llm-owner-79e8f                running (admitted)
cpu-a    research  job-research-run-095b9             LAYER 2 pending: couldn't assign flavors to pod set main: insufficient unused quota for cpu in flavor cpu-ondemand, 1 more needed

checks.description: research was admitted with 3 CPUs although its own share is 1
checks.because: The cohort lets a team borrow what others lend, up to the borrowing limit. Two CPUs came from llm and vision.

checks.description: llm, asking for its own share, was admitted
checks.because: llm's share is guaranteed, so Kueue reclaims it from whoever is borrowing it.
reclaimWithinCohort is Any, so a queue within its nominal quota may preempt workloads that are borrowing from the cohort.

checks.description: the preempted job was requeued, not lost
checks.because: Preempted Workloads go back to the queue and run again when capacity returns.

notes: Kueue's own words for the preemption: 'Preempted to accommodate a workload (UID: a0f1cde0-d7ac-4eec-ae90-1cedd84d911b, JobUID: 141d7f52-642a-4b6c-b248-992cd7bb5511) due to reclamation within the cohort; preemptor path: /cpu-fleet/llm-cpu; '
